scope.supporting: Four product TOCs and recursive XML load closure, two unchanged third-party Lua libraries and their contracts/licenses, three build/sync/font tools, current formal documentation, test entrypoints, runtime media, canonical .lock and embedded library.
scope.notDeleted: Historical investigations, raw measurements, public APIs/assets not currently consumed by the product, and unrelated ignored workspace resources.

process: Each stage covers its complete scope. Confirmed findings are fixed and relevant behavior verified before the next stage. Repeat architecture, performance and hygiene until each scope completes a cycle with no new actionable finding. Core, Group, Notes and shared scopes froze after their clean A3/P3/H3 cycle; the UI-only P3 repair was followed by a complete UI A4/P4/H4 cycle. Unchanged frozen scopes were not falsely counted as re-audited in A4/P4/H4.

Late Notes module readiness attaches only the visible consuming page and refreshes its marks.
Changing the shared Context window invalidates its alpha write cache.
Navigation hiding stops and settles child selection motion.
Switch hiding stops and settles its knob motion.

Native input/button acquisition honors synchronous release, context hide and control handoff callbacks.

List content shrink ends a clamped zero-displacement scroll immediately.
Five-member roster updates skip unchanged role-badge geometry.
Notes known class/spec resolution reuses successful class-aware metadata without mixing generic API labels.
Cold enabling of Notes subscribes and refreshes the visible consumer once.
Player tooltip opening performs one interactive reset.
Note-type changes update only type controls, preserving class/spec selections and text.
Member binding resolves the stable identity once within the same binding call; click-time revalidation remains.

Applicant list wheel input stops immediately when the clamped target equals its displayed position.
Interactive tooltip wheel input stops immediately when the clamped target equals its displayed position.
Removed the unconsumed Create page activity reference; local activity and form selection remain.
Removed the unused product UI logoButton alias; the shared Context retains the real logo button and animation anchor.
Removed the always-true private application cancel isCancel field and its redundant hover condition; enabled-state checks remain.

layout.representationCheck: The first post-P2 raw-storage comparison matched 3/36 scenes. Every remaining mismatch resolved to an omitted white Texture tint versus explicitly stored [1,1,1,1], because SetIconState correctly skipped that unchanged write. Resolving only this existing getter default restored 36/36; no color, position or layout tolerance was added.
layout.method: Before H1 all snapshots were byte-equivalent after canonical JSON serialization to the pre-goal baseline. After H1, remove only explicitly hidden Texture leaves without incoming node/anchor/scroll references, renumber every node and reference, and compare every remaining property. After P2, additionally resolve an absent Texture vertex-tint field to its existing getter default [1,1,1,1]; omitting the unchanged white setter no longer creates that optional stub field. All 36 scenes match.
layout.limits: Offline widget-tree equivalence does not establish native pixels, hardware hit testing, secure operations or all scales.

runtime.previousKnownLimit: The 1.1.1 mixed real-data/event workload sampled 27.070 MB, exceeding the 20 MB target. That historical failure is retained and is not overwritten by offline verification.

limits: No absolute claim that all possible bugs, client states or third-party interactions are absent.
No result truncation, refresh delay increase, motion reduction, forced collection in business code, or GC policy change introduced.
